name: Cisco ASA — High Volume of Denied Inbound Connections from One IP
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302014" and _raw_log contains "SYN Timeout"
// 106023 denies are not parsed (and not emitted); an unanswered inbound connection shows
// as 302013 Built + 302014 Teardown "SYN Timeout", 0 bytes. The initiator is the "for" side.
| alter source_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "for (?:outside|internet|untrust)\S*?:(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/"), 0),
        dst = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, " to \S+?:(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/"), 0),
        dport = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, " to \S+?:\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+/(\d+)"), 0)
| filter source_ip != null
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp count() as failed_connections, count_distinct(dst) as targets, count_distinct(dport) as ports,
       values(dst) as dst_ips, values(dport) as dst_ports by source_ip, _time
| filter failed_connections >= 30
| fields source_ip, failed_connections, targets, ports, dst_ips, dst_ports
description: 30+ inbound connections from one outside address torn down with SYN Timeout (never answered) within 10 minutes: a scan or connection flood against the perimeter.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — High Volume of Denied Inbound Connections from One IP
alert_description:
What fired: External IP generating an abnormal count of 106023 denies — scanner or attack pattern.

Why it matters: an actor is enumerating hosts, services, shares, or accounts to map the environment. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1046 - Network Service Discovery (TA0007 - Discovery).

Investigate:
  - Identify the scanning source and the number/range of targets it touched.
  - Confirm the source is not an authorized scanner/vuln tool; look for follow-on access to any enumerated target.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
